# OpenOrbis sample graphics support

This folder contains the unmodified `graphics.h`, `graphics.cpp` and `log.h` support files from the OpenOrbis PS4 Toolchain sample renderer.

- Upstream: https://github.com/OpenOrbis/OpenOrbis-PS4-Toolchain
- Source revision: `0a1aaf9dd4a92695538bdeb09fb056d06dd11725`
- Original location: `samples/_common/`
- License: GNU GPL version 3; see [GPL-3.0.txt](GPL-3.0.txt).

These files are used only by the native PS4 display test application. The test application is built from source in this repository. The original KI1 game emulator is not part of this package.
